subject: Pen test evidence & remediation ETA — keystore rotation, logging, authz
messages:
From: Jack Tremblay <jack.tremblay@avasec.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Ops <security@acme-health.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for pen-test report + remediation artifacts (Acme Health scope)

Marcus / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the external pen test engagement. Acme Health's security team asked us to obtain the final pen-test report and a short remediation pack for a subset of high/critical findings they flagged during intake:

- Private keystore exposure (finding #AC-01) — evidence of rotation / new key ids
- Secrets in S3 buckets with public ACLs (finding #AC-03) — mitigation and proof of removal
- Incomplete audit logging for service-to-service auth (finding #AC-07) — config or log sample showing events captured
- Network egress rule allowing broad CIDR (finding #AC-09) — firewall rule change evidence

Can you please provide: (1) the full pen-test report PDF (redacted as necessary), (2) a remediation checklist mapping each finding to the code/PR or config change, (3) timestamps/screenshots/log samples showing the fix is live (where applicable), and (4) an ETA for final closure?

Attachments: none from our side right now. We will treat this as evidence for their SIG and CAIQ reviews. If any of the items above require a longer remediation window, call that out and provide compensating controls we can share in the interim.

Best,
Jack Tremblay
Principal Consultant, AvaSec
pentest@avasec.com
[attachment: redwood-2026-pen-test-report.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB)]

Preliminary ETA: keystore rotation + secrets removal: 48–72 hours; logging config change: 5 business days for full pipeline proof; network egress tightening: 72 hours to apply rules in staging + 5 days to roll to prod depending on release window.

I'll follow up with a checklist that maps finding IDs to PRs and evidence links.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Operations (responding for compliance)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jack Tremblay <jack.tremblay@avasec.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for pen-test report + remediation artifacts (Acme Health scope)

Jack / Marcus — summary of remediation actions and evidence links below. I’m tracking each item in the attached checklist and will add CI/CD links as PRs merge.

1) Keystore exposure (finding #AC-01)
- Action: rotated all affected keys, retired legacy key ids, and revoked access from the compromised IAM role.
- Evidence: keystore-rotation-log-sample.txt (attached), KMS rotation job run id: run-2026-07-22-03, PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/9f3b2a1
- ETA: completed (rotation job finished 2026-07-22T03:12:14Z).

2) Secrets in S3 (finding #AC-03)
- Action: removed incorrect public ACLs, scanned bucket inventory, rotated exposed secrets, and added automated S3 ACL guardrails (policy + detection).
- Evidence: S3 ACL change audit entry (link in Drive), PR for guardrail: https://github.com/redwood-inference/security/pull/412
- ETA: completed 2026-07-22T06:40:00Z; secrets rotated 2026-07-22T07:05:00Z.

3) Service-to-service audit logging gap (finding #AC-07)
- Action: updated service-auth middleware to emit standardized audit events; collector pipeline updated to persist auth events to long-term index.
- Evidence: sample log lines (attached), collector config change PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/189
- ETA: config deployed to staging 2026-07-23; production rollout planned 2026-07-28 pending canary verification. Expected evidence (prod logs) available by 2026-07-29.

4) Network egress rule (finding #AC-09)
- Action: narrowed egress CIDR for the affected subnet, added a deny-by-default outbound rule, and created a temporary exception for the vendor IPs used in testing.
- Evidence: firewall rule change screenshot (Drive), change control ticket: NET-1843.
- ETA: change applied to staging 2026-07-22; prod schedule depends on the maintenance window — targeted prod apply 2026-07-25.

Attachments included: remediation-checklist-ACME-3421.xlsx, keystore-rotation-log-sample.txt. Full pen-test report previously attached by Jack.

Interim compensating controls for Acme Health review:
- Short-term: restrict API keys by referrer and rotate keys frequently; enable alerting on key use anomalies.
- Medium-term: enforce S3 default-deny and auto-remediation playbook for public ACLs.

If Acme needs signed attestation for any item, let me know and we’ll produce a short attestation doc once evidence is uploaded to the Drive folder.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: remediation-checklist-ACME-3421.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]
